contracts.name: loaded result
contracts.description: LoadedAuth carries policy stamp and Replace(Some/None) versus Preserve(attempted/failure). AuthLoadError distinguishes Policy, Source and CacheUnavailable. Actual reload and guarded reload consume it through commit_auth_load.

contracts.name: commit
contracts.description: Credentials write lock precedes exact policy guard. Prepare comparisons outside policy lock; only owned swaps inside it. Assignment is the policy linearization point. Drop policy guard before native network/watch notifications, retain credentials lock through notifications, and drop retired auth/failure values and trace after locks.

contracts.name: origin
contracts.description: Native source/parsing and actual external resolver Transient errors preserve cache. Successful absence/native filtering and private NativePolicyRejection are authoritative None. External Restriction Transient clears; Permanent/Policy preserve existing classifier-specific disposition. Unknown permission errors stay Source.

contracts.name: failure metadata
contracts.description: Install permanent failure metadata only for matching current credentials under a current policy guard. Preserve never restores attempted old auth over a newer cache.

contracts.name: actual acquisition and legacy projections
contracts.description: Public reload bool retains coarse auth equality; guarded reload retains credential-change projection. Raw auth_cached stays unchecked. Every actual auth() return, including proactive-refresh error fallback, and the final auth_with_http_client_factory capture validate the CURRENT cache directly against native restrictions. Credential read lock prevents a concurrent cached replacement during validation/preparation; exact policy guard provides the acquisition linearization check. Only two fixed native preparation closures run before policy lock; prepared values are returned/dropped after guards. Unavailable/stale/rejected policy returns None without clearing newer cached credentials.

scope_limits: Compiled native policy-stamped in-memory reload publication and point-in-time current cached acquisition only; not independent auth/catalog extraction or broker activation.
